projection_cases.derivation: No income/return/tax: 30000 - 20000 = 10000, then only 10000 of 20000 paid.

Ordinary taxable=40000-16100=23900; ordinary tax=2620. Zero-rate LTCG room=49450-23900=25550. Draw D solves D=60000+2620+0.15*(0.5D-25550), hence D=58787.5/0.925. Gain=D/2; NIIT=0. Closing=300000-160000-tax.
Age73: 265000/26.5=10000; next opening IRA=255000. Age74: 255000/25.5=10000. Cash=10000 then 20000. Income below standard deduction; transfers preserve total.
